remove() vs pop() vs del vs clear() - what is the difference?

Supplied answer
remove(value) deletes the first matching value and raises ValueError if it is absent. pop(index) deletes by
index and returns the removed item (pop() with no argument removes the last). del my_list[i] deletes by
index without returning anything and can also delete slices or the whole variable. clear() empties the list.
